_note: What you see: After a leaked master password, rotate the key and choose emergency contacts again.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Na een gelekt hoofdwachtwoord de sleutel roteren en noodcontacten opnieuw kiezen.
Na: Mijn masterwachtwoord is gecompromit: After: My master password is compromised
Ga ervan uit dat elke waarde in deze klu: Assume every value in this vault has leaked and change them all at the source.
Het roteren van uw sleutel herstelt de t: Rotating your key restores access to your secrets, so you can change those values in order. It does not make the old values safe.
Kies welke noodcontacten uw nieuwe sleut: Choose which emergency contacts may receive your new key. Only tick people you appointed yourself and still trust: whoever held your session may have added a contact.
Anouk Bakker, wachttijd in dagen: 7: Anouk Bakker, waiting period in days: 7
Tom Visser, wachttijd in dagen: 3: Tom Visser, waiting period in days: 3
2 geheimen konden niet worden ontsleutel: 2 secrets could not be decrypted with your old key, so they were not migrated.
Toch afronden en de toegang tot 2 geheim: Finish anyway and lose access to 2 secrets
